posts.title: Is Tech Hiring Broken? Here's What I'm Seeing | Coffee with Debbie #1
posts.description: Episode 1 of my new show: why I think hiring in tech is broken, DevRel travel, the San Francisco bias, how I apply for jobs with AI, and why we need the human touch.

posts.title: Get your site agent-ready
posts.description: How to give AI agents a short map of your site, a full index, and clean markdown copies of your posts, and why that helps even if the big crawlers do not use the file yet.

posts.title: Build an Offline AI Study App with Local Models (Liquid AI LFM3-1.7B)
posts.description: I ran Liquid AI's LFM3-1.7B in the browser with WebGPU and built Grading Buddy, an offline study app that answers only from notes I've checked.
